primary_reduction: median of all three valid completed replicates; incomplete cases excluded from paired comparisons, never imputed
pilot_selection: Within each antigen, sort by (binder length, condition ID); select indices0,floor((n-1)/2),n-1. No labels, scores, or outcomes enter selection.
relative_pdb_path_note: Worker pdb_path is relative to run staging root. Stage files from input_pdb.local_path and verify pdb_sha256 before submission; source_remote_path is provenance only.
